description: Kiosk Satellite shows the hidden Echo Weather dashboard (/echo-weather/weather, Meridian forecast with the animated sky) as the Echo's screensaver 6:30-8:00 (screensaver.schedule, set in KS). KS widgets draw over every screensaver mode, so they go off for that slot and back on for the photos. KS's At a glance row stays off (screensaver.glance_enabled false in KS). Same as ks_kitchen_morning_widgets, which runs 5:30-8:00.
